policy.method: public web/search metadata and public pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.

candidates.title: Pictet global multi-asset fund triples to $5.1B on China inflows
candidates.whyItMayWork: Large round-number fund growth plus China retail demand, Treasuries/gold/AI-tech exposure gives a compact investing explainer angle.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Fund-flow story is less emotional than community drama and needs careful context to avoid implying investment advice.

candidates.title: EU set to propose under-15 restrictions covering social media and AI chatbots
candidates.whyItMayWork: Immediate everyday impact and a clear question hook: which services would be restricted and at what ages?
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Proposal details can change during negotiation, so cards must label it proposed rather than enacted law.

candidates.title: Employee alleges manager threatened pay/promotion consequences over food boxes
candidates.whyItMayWork: Simple workplace conflict with an instantly understandable fairness question and strong comment-discussion potential.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: This is a secondary account of an unverified Reddit allegation; it must remain framed as a claim and not a fact about an identifiable employer/person.

candidates.title: Same-age wife mistaken for husband's mother sparks awkward-story thread
candidates.whyItMayWork: Low-stakes awkward humor with many follow-up anecdotes and an easy multi-card story structure.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Avoid age/appearance degradation and do not expose private individuals or reproduce user media without rights review.
